put.description: Creates an assistant owned by the calling user in the caller's tenant. Name is required. Id, TenantId, UserId, CreatedUtc, and LastUpdateUtc are assigned by the server and any supplied values are ignored, except with the administrator API key, which belongs to no tenant or user: TenantId is then required in the body (400 when missing, 404 when the tenant does not exist), and the assistant is owned by the body's UserId (400 unless it is a user of that tenant) or else the tenant's first administrator. Default assistant settings are created alongside the assistant: RAG is enabled against the collection of the first ingestion rule in the tenant (when one exists), and the first available completion and embedding endpoints are assigned when they can be enumerated. Any authenticated user may create an assistant.

post.description: Unauthenticated, OpenAI-compatible chat completion. Retrieves relevant chunks from the assistant's collection (RAG, with optional retrieval gate, query rewrite, and reranking), injects the assistant system prompt and context, compacts long conversations, and calls the configured inference endpoint. The response format is controlled by the assistant's Streaming setting (the request 'stream' field is ignored): when streaming is disabled the response is a JSON chat.completion object; when enabled it is a text/event-stream of chat.completion.chunk events terminated by 'data: [DONE]'. The final streamed chunk carries usage, retrieval, citations, and (when exposed by policy) tool_calls. Tool-enabled streaming may also emit named progress events (assistant.tool_iteration.started, assistant.tool_call.started, assistant.tool_call.heartbeat, assistant.tool_call.completed, assistant.tool_call.failed, assistant.tool_call.denied), and compaction emits a chunk with status 'Compacting the conversation...'. Once streaming has begun, inference errors are reported in-stream as a chunk with status 'Error' rather than as an HTTP error. attached_document_ids constrains retrieval to completed documents in the assistant collection; attached_document_ids plus local_attachments must not exceed DocumentAttachmentMaxCount. When X-Thread-ID is supplied, the turn is recorded in chat history for that thread.

put.description: Creates or replaces the settings for an assistant. Owner or administrator only. The body is validated: InferenceEndpointId is required; SearchMode must be Vector, FullText, or Hybrid; QueryRewritePrompt must contain {prompt}; RerankPrompt must contain {query} and {chunks}; SlackAppToken must start with xapp- and SlackBotToken with xoxb-, and all four Slack fields are required when EnableSlack is true; ToolPolicyJson must be valid AssistantToolPolicy JSON. Values are normalized: endpoint identifiers are trimmed (blank optional endpoints become null), DocumentAttachmentMaxCount is clamped to 1-100, TextWeight to 0.0-1.0, RetrievalIncludeNeighbors to 0-10, and an unknown FullTextSearchType falls back to TsRank. Id, AssistantId, and CreatedUtc are assigned by the server. When the Slack configuration changes, the assistant's Slack connection is refreshed in the background.

put.description: Replaces a crawl plan with the supplied values. Id, TenantId, and CreatedUtc are preserved from the stored plan and LastUpdateUtc is set by the server; every other field is taken from the request body, so send the complete plan. Repository settings are revalidated. RepositorySettings is polymorphic and selected by RepositoryType (or by its own RepositoryType property): Web uses AuthenticationType (None, Basic, ApiKey, BearerToken), Username, Password, ApiKeyHeader, ApiKeyValue, BearerToken, UserAgent, StartUrl (required), UseHeadlessBrowser, FollowLinks, FollowRedirects, ExtractSitemapLinks, RestrictToChildUrls, RestrictToSubdomain, RestrictToRootDomain, IgnoreRobotsTxt, MaxDepth (1-100), MaxParallelTasks (1-64), and CrawlDelayMs (0-60000); CIFS uses CifsHostname, CifsUsername, CifsPassword, CifsShareName, and IncludeSubdirectories; NFS uses NfsHostname, NfsUserId, NfsGroupId, NfsShareName, NfsVersion, and IncludeSubdirectories; S3 uses S3Endpoint (empty for Amazon S3), S3Region, S3BucketName, S3AccessKey, and S3SecretKey; AzureBlob uses AzureAccountName, AzureAccessKey, AzureContainer, and AzureEndpoint (empty for https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/); GoogleCloud uses GcpProjectId, GcpBucketName, GcpJsonCredentials (a service account JSON key), and GcpEndpoint; LocalDisk uses DiskPath (an absolute folder inside the server's Crawl.AllowedLocalPaths) and IncludeSubdirectories; Git uses GitRepositoryUrl (https://github.com/owner/repo) and GitAccessToken. Bucket, container, and repository settings name the whole store; use Filter.ObjectPrefix to crawl one folder. put.description: Global administrators only; other callers receive 403. Creates a completion (inference) endpoint in Partio. The caller's JSON is merged onto an empty object (TenantId defaults to "default") and forwarded to Partio PUT /v1.0/endpoints/completion. SupportsToolCalling, ToolCallingApiFormat (OllamaChat or OpenAIChatCompletions), SupportsParallelToolCalls, and SupportsStreamingToolCalls are stored in Partio as the reserved label 'assistanthub:tool-calling' and reserved tags 'AssistantHub.SupportsToolCalling', 'AssistantHub.ToolCallingApiFormat', 'AssistantHub.SupportsParallelToolCalls', and 'AssistantHub.SupportsStreamingToolCalls'; other labels and tags are preserved. MaxConcurrentRequests (default 2), MaxQueueDepth (default 0), and MaximumTimeoutMs (default 60000) control Partio's per-endpoint concurrency: with MaxQueueDepth 0 requests over the concurrency limit are rejected with 429, while a positive value queues them until a slot frees or the request times out with 504. On success the response is re-serialized with the tool-calling fields read back from the tags, and the endpoint is registered with AssistantHub's health-check service when HealthCheckEnabled and Active are true. The request is forwarded to Partio and Partio's HTTP status code is relayed; non-2xx bodies are relayed unchanged, so Partio validation (400) and not-found (404) errors pass through.

EnableRetrievalGate.description: Whether the LLM-based retrieval gate is enabled. When enabled, an LLM call classifies whether each user message requires new retrieval or can be answered from existing conversation context.

EnableQueryRewrite.description: Whether LLM-based query rewrite is enabled. When enabled, the user's prompt is rewritten into multiple semantically varied queries before retrieval to improve recall.

QueryRewritePrompt.description: The prompt template used for query rewriting. Must contain the {prompt} placeholder which is replaced with the user's message. When null or empty, a built-in default prompt is used.

EnableReranking.description: Whether LLM-based re-ranking of retrieved chunks is enabled. When enabled, retrieved chunks are scored by an LLM for relevance and low-scoring chunks are filtered out before context injection.

RerankerTopK.description: Maximum number of chunks to keep after re-ranking (min 1).

RerankerScoreThreshold.description: Minimum LLM relevance score (0.0–10.0) for a chunk to survive re-ranking.

RerankPrompt.description: Custom re-ranking prompt template. Must contain {query} and {chunks} placeholders. When null, a built-in default prompt is used.

EnableCitations.description: Whether to include citation metadata in chat completion responses. When enabled, retrieved context chunks are indexed in the system prompt and the model is instructed to cite sources using bracket notation [1], [2], etc.

CitationLinkMode.description: Controls document download linking in citation cards. Values: "None" (display-only), "Authenticated" (requires bearer token), "Public" (unauthenticated server-proxied download).

EnableDocumentAttachments.description: Whether public assistant chat users may attach completed documents from the assistant collection.

DocumentAttachmentMaxCount.description: Maximum number of documents that may be attached to one chat request.

ExposeDocumentSourceUrls.description: Whether public document-selection responses may include source URLs.

RetrievalTopK.description: Number of top results to retrieve.

RetrievalScoreThreshold.description: Minimum vector similarity for retrieval results (0.0 to 1.0). In Hybrid mode it drops only chunks that the vector leg found on its own with a similarity below it; chunks the full-text leg found are kept. FullText results are not held to it; FullTextMinimumScore is their cutoff.

SearchMode.description: Search mode for retrieval: Vector, FullText, or Hybrid.

TextWeight.description: Share of the full-text leg in hybrid mode (0.0 to 1.0); the vector leg gets 1.0 - TextWeight. With the default Rrf fusion the fused score is ((1 - w) / (k + vectorRank) + w / (k + textRank)) * (k + 1), so a chunk ranked first by both legs scores 1.0 and a chunk found only by the text leg scores at most w. With Linear fusion the score is a blend of the two legs' normalized scores. Only applies when SearchMode is "Hybrid".

FusionStrategy.description: How hybrid search combines its vector and full-text legs: "Rrf" (weighted reciprocal rank fusion, the default) or "Linear" (blend of the legs' normalized scores). Only applies when SearchMode is "Hybrid".

RrfK.description: The RRF constant k (1 to 100,000). Smaller values reward top ranks more strongly; larger values flatten the difference between adjacent ranks. Only applies to Rrf fusion. Default 60.

FusionCandidatePool.description: Number of candidates each hybrid leg retrieves before fusion (1 to 10,000). Null uses RecallDB's default, max(RetrievalTopK x 4, 100) capped at 1,000.

RecencyWeight.description: Weight of a recency signal added to Rrf fusion (0.0 to 1.0): newer documents rank higher among otherwise similar candidates. 0 disables it. Only applies to Rrf fusion in hybrid mode.

ContextOrder.description: Order of retrieved context in the prompt: "Score" (most relevant first, the default) or "ReadingOrder" (chunks grouped by document, documents ordered by their best chunk, chunks in document order, with adjacent chunks merged). Does not change which chunks are retrieved or how they are ranked.

FullTextSearchType.description: Full-text ranking function: "TsRank" (term frequency) or "TsRankCd" (cover density, rewards proximity).

FullTextLanguage.description: PostgreSQL text search language configuration. Controls stemming and stop words.

FullTextNormalization.description: Full-text score normalization bitmask. 32 = normalized 0-1 (recommended for hybrid).

FullTextMinimumScore.description: Minimum full-text score threshold. Documents with TextScore below this are excluded. Null means no threshold.

RetrievalIncludeNeighbors.description: Number of neighboring chunks to retrieve before and after each matched chunk (0-10). When set, each search result from RecallDB includes up to N chunks before and N chunks after the matched position within the same document. 0 means no neighbors.

MaxRetries.description: Number of times to retry a Partio processing/embedding call after a transient failure (HTTP 408, 429, 502, 503, or 504) before giving up. Zero disables retries. Partio v0.5.0 enforces per-endpoint concurrency and queue limits and can return 429 (queue full) or 504 (queued-wait/upstream timeout) under load, which are safe to retry.

RetryDelayMs.description: Base delay, in milliseconds, between transient-failure retries of a Partio call. The effective delay grows exponentially per attempt and is capped at 60,000 ms. Zero disables the delay (retries fire immediately).

RequestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout, in milliseconds, for a single Partio request. Chunking and embedding a large document is one request, so this bounds the largest document that can be ingested. Minimum 1,000 ms; default 900,000 ms.

QueryEmbeddingTimeoutMs.description: Timeout, in milliseconds, for a single query-embedding request made at retrieval time. Kept separate from RequestTimeoutMs , which is sized for ingesting large documents, so a stalled embedding model cannot hold a chat request for minutes. A timed-out query embedding is not retried. Minimum 1,000 ms; default 30,000 ms.

QueryEmbeddingCacheSize.description: Maximum number of query embeddings kept in the in-process cache, keyed by embedding endpoint and query text. Repeated questions and multi-stage retrieval reuse a cached vector instead of calling the model again. Zero disables the cache. Default 10,000.

IngestionChunkingConfig.description: Chunking configuration for an ingestion rule.

Strategy.description: Chunking strategy (e.g. None, FixedTokenCount, SentenceBased, ParagraphBased, RegexBased, etc.). When set to "None", chunking is skipped and the entire document content is treated as a single chunk.

FixedTokenCount.description: Fixed token count per chunk. Default: 256. Minimum: 1. Values below the minimum are clamped.

OverlapCount.description: Number of overlapping tokens between chunks. Default: 0. Minimum: 0. Values below the minimum are clamped.

OverlapPercentage.description: Overlap percentage between chunks. Default: null. Minimum: 0.0. Maximum: 1.0. Values outside the range are clamped.

RowGroupSize.description: Number of rows per group for row-based chunking. Default: 5. Minimum: 1. Values below the minimum are clamped.

ContextPrefix.description: Context prefix to prepend to each chunk.

CellMode.description: How extracted content is sent for chunking. "Flat" sends the whole document as one text cell (the Strategy applies to all of it). "Structured" sends each section's text, each table and each list as its own cell, so tables and lists use TableStrategy and ListStrategy, chunks never span sections, and every chunk carries page and sheet tags.

TableStrategy.description: Chunking strategy for tables in Structured mode: Row, RowWithHeaders, RowGroupWithHeaders (the default; RowGroupSize rows per chunk, header repeated), KeyValuePairs or WholeTable.

ListStrategy.description: Chunking strategy for lists in Structured mode: WholeList (the default) or ListEntry.

ContextHeader.description: Context embedded with each chunk in Structured mode, without changing the stored chunk text: "None", "Title" (the document name) or "TitleAndHeadings" (the document name and the section's heading path).

IngestionEmbeddingConfig.description: Embedding configuration for an ingestion rule.

EmbeddingEndpointId.description: ID of the embedding endpoint to use.

L2Normalization.description: Whether to apply L2 normalization to embeddings.

TaskPrefixes.description: Prepend the embedding model's document task prefix (for example "search_document: " for nomic-embed-text) when embedding chunks. The stored chunk text is unchanged. Assistants searching the collection should turn on EmbeddingTaskPrefixes so queries get the matching query prefix.

Name.description: Display name for the ingestion rule.

Bucket.description: S3 bucket name for document storage.

CollectionId.description: RecallDB collection GUID for API calls.

VerbexIndexId.description: Verbex index identifier for full-text indexing. Null uses the tenant default.

Labels.description: Labels to apply to ingested documents.

Tags.description: Tags to apply to ingested documents.

CreatedUtc.description: Timestamp when the record was created in UTC.

LastUpdateUtc.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated in UTC.

IngestionSummarizationConfig.description: Summarization configuration for an ingestion rule.

CompletionEndpointId.description: ID of a Partio completion endpoint used for summarization.

SummarizationPrompt.description: Custom prompt template for summarization. Null uses Partio default.

MaxSummaryTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for each summary. Default: 1024. Minimum: 128. Values below the minimum are clamped.

MinCellLength.description: Minimum cell content length (in characters) to trigger summarization. Default: 128. Minimum: 0. Values below the minimum are clamped.

MaxParallelTasks.description: Maximum number of parallel summarization tasks. Default: 1. Minimum: 1. Values below the minimum are clamped.

MaxRetriesPerSummary.description: Maximum retry attempts for an individual cell. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Values below the minimum are clamped.

MaxRetries.description: Global failure limit across all cells (circuit breaker). Default: 9. Minimum: 0. Values below the minimum are clamped.

TimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each summarization request. Default: 300000. Minimum: 100. Values below the minimum are clamped.

LocalDiskCrawlRepositorySettings.description: Folder on the AssistantHub server. DiskPath must be inside one of the folders listed in the server setting Crawl.AllowedLocalPaths; with none listed, local disk crawling is disabled. Files reached through symbolic links or junctions are skipped.

DiskPath.description: Absolute path of the folder on the AssistantHub server, for example /app/crawl-sources/handbook (Docker) or D:\Shared\Documents. The folder must exist; it is never created.

MinimumSeverity.description: Minimum severity level for logging (0 through 7).

EnableColors.description: Enable or disable color output in console logging.

Servers.description: List of syslog servers to which log messages should be sent.

NfsVersion.description: NFS protocol version. Only V3 is supported; V2 and V4 fail validation (400).

NfsPort.description: TCP port of the NFS service. Null uses 2049.

NfsMountPort.description: TCP port of the MOUNT service. Null or 0 discovers it through the portmapper.

NfsPortmapperPort.description: TCP port of the portmapper (rpcbind). Null uses 111.

PartioEndpointConfig.description: Typed representation of a Partio embedding or completion endpoint.

MaxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum concurrent requests allowed for this endpoint.

MaxQueueDepth.description: Maximum number of requests Partio queues once MaxConcurrentRequests upstream calls are in flight. Zero (the default) rejects excess requests immediately with 429; a positive value lets up to that many additional requests wait for a slot before Partio returns 429, and a queued request that waits past MaximumTimeoutMs returns 504.

MaximumTimeoutMs.description: Maximum request timeout, in milliseconds, applied to upstream calls made through this endpoint. This is distinct from the health check timeout.

ContextSize.description: Context window size (maximum tokens) for the model served by this endpoint. 0 means unspecified.

SupportsToolCalling.description: Whether this endpoint explicitly supports model tool calls.

ToolCallingApiFormat.description: Tool-calling wire format, for example OpenAIChatCompletions.

SupportsParallelToolCalls.description: Whether this endpoint supports multiple tool calls in one assistant turn.

SupportsStreamingToolCalls.description: Whether this endpoint supports tool calls while streaming responses.

HealthyThreshold.description: Consecutive successes required for healthy state.

UnhealthyThreshold.description: Consecutive failures required for unhealthy state.

HealthCheckUseAuth.description: Whether auth is used for health checks.

RequestTimeoutMs.description: AssistantHub's timeout, in milliseconds, for its own calls to this endpoint: answer calls to a completion endpoint, or query embeddings through an embedding endpoint. Null uses the server default ( Inference.RequestTimeoutMs or Chunking.QueryEmbeddingTimeoutMs ). Stored as the AssistantHub.RequestTimeoutMs tag.

UtilityTimeoutMs.description: AssistantHub's timeout, in milliseconds, for utility steps (retrieval gate, query and conversation rewrite, LLM rerank) on this completion endpoint. Null uses Inference.UtilityTimeoutMs . Stored as the AssistantHub.UtilityTimeoutMs tag.

PartioEndpointRequest.description: Typed request payload for creating or updating a Partio-managed endpoint.

MaxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum concurrent requests allowed for this endpoint.

MaxQueueDepth.description: Maximum number of requests Partio queues once MaxConcurrentRequests upstream calls are in flight. Zero rejects excess requests immediately with 429; a positive value lets that many additional requests wait for a slot. Left null on partial updates to preserve the stored value.

SupportsToolCalling.description: Whether this endpoint explicitly supports model tool calls.

ToolCallingApiFormat.description: Tool-calling wire format, for example OpenAIChatCompletions.

SupportsParallelToolCalls.description: Whether this endpoint supports multiple tool calls in one assistant turn.

SupportsStreamingToolCalls.description: Whether this endpoint supports tool calls while streaming responses.

HealthCheckUseAuth.description: Whether auth is used on health checks.

RequestTimeoutMs.description: AssistantHub's timeout, in milliseconds (1,000 to 3,600,000), for its own calls to this endpoint: answer calls to a completion endpoint, or query embeddings through an embedding endpoint. 0 clears it (server default); omit it on updates to keep the stored value.

UtilityTimeoutMs.description: AssistantHub's timeout, in milliseconds (1,000 to 3,600,000), for utility steps on this completion endpoint (retrieval gate, rewrites, LLM rerank). 0 clears it; omit it on updates to keep the stored value.

PassthroughObject.description: Pass-through JSON object returned by a subordinate service.

ModelName.description: Name of the model being pulled.

Status.description: Current status message from the pull operation.

Digest.description: Digest of the layer currently being downloaded.

TotalBytes.description: Total bytes to download for the current layer.

CompletedBytes.description: Bytes completed for the current layer.

IsComplete.description: Whether the pull operation has completed.

HasError.description: Whether the pull operation encountered an error.

ErrorMessage.description: Error message if the pull operation failed.

Endpoint.description: Endpoint URL for the RecallDb service.

AccessKey.description: Access key for the RecallDb service.

DashboardUrl.description: Browser URL for the RecallDb dashboard.

SupportsMultiDocumentFilter.description: Indicates whether RecallDB accepts a native multi-document DocumentIds search filter. When false, AssistantHub loops over single DocumentId searches and merges results server-side.

FilteredEfSearch.description: HNSW ef_search sent with vector and hybrid searches that carry a label, tag or document filter. pgvector applies filters after the index scan, so a restrictive filter can leave fewer than the requested number of rows at RecallDB's default, which only covers the page. Zero leaves RecallDB's default in place. Range 0 to 1,000; default 400.

RequestHistoryEntry.description: Captured HTTP request and response entry.

TraceId.description: Trace identifier shared by chat history, request history, and logs.

ChatHistoryId.description: Chat history identifier associated with this request, when available.

Success.description: Whether the request succeeded.

RequestBodyTruncated.description: Whether request body capture was truncated.

ResponseBodyTruncated.description: Whether response body capture was truncated.

RequestBodyIsBinary.description: Whether the request body is represented as a binary placeholder.

ResponseBodyIsBinary.description: Whether the response body is represented as a binary placeholder.

CreatedUtc.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

LastUpdateUtc.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

RetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain request-history records.

MaxRequestBodyBytes.description: Maximum request body bytes to capture.

MaxResponseBodyBytes.description: Maximum response body bytes to capture.

CaptureBodies.description: Whether request and response bodies are captured.

IncludeUnauthenticatedAssistantTraffic.description: Whether unauthenticated assistant traffic should be captured.

ExcludedContentTypes.description: Response content types to skip body capture for.

RetrievalChunk.description: A retrieved chunk with source identification and scoring.

document_id.description: The document identifier from RecallDB (maps to AssistantDocument.Id).

rerank_score.description: LLM-assigned relevance score from re-ranking (0.0–10.0), null when re-ranking is disabled.

fusion_score.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion score computed across multiple query result lists. Null when RRF is disabled or only a single query was issued.

text_score.description: Full-text relevance score component (null in vector-only mode).

vector_score.description: Raw vector similarity reported by the store (null when the vector leg did not score this chunk). In hybrid mode Score is the fused score, so this is the only raw similarity available.

vector_rank.description: 1-based rank in the hybrid vector leg (null outside hybrid search or when absent from that leg).

text_rank.description: 1-based rank in the hybrid text leg (null outside hybrid search or when absent from that leg).

content.description: Text content of the matching chunk.

position.description: Positional index of this chunk within its source document.

neighbors.description: Neighboring chunks surrounding this match in positional order. Populated when IncludeNeighbors is specified. Null when not requested.

page_start.description: First page (or slide) of the source document this chunk came from, when known.

page_end.description: Last page (or slide) of the source document this chunk came from, when known.

sheet.description: Spreadsheet sheet this chunk came from, when known.

section.description: Heading path of the section this chunk came from, when known.

superseded_by.description: Identifier of the document that supersedes this chunk's document, when the chunk is kept as outdated.

RetrievalStageSnapshot.description: The ranked chunk list as it stood after one stage of the retrieval pipeline.

stage.description: Stage name: search (one per issued query), fused (after multi-query fusion or merge), attachment_filter , rerank .

query.description: The query issued, for search stages.

S3CrawlRepositorySettings.description: Amazon S3 or S3-compatible (MinIO, Less3, Ceph, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2) bucket. Object keys are paths inside the bucket; use Filter.ObjectPrefix to crawl one folder.

S3Endpoint.description: Service URL of an S3-compatible store, for example http://minio.example.com:9000/. Null or empty uses Amazon S3 in S3Region. The scheme decides whether TLS is used; path-style requests are sent.

S3Region.description: Region, for example us-east-1. Required for Amazon S3; S3-compatible stores usually accept any value.

S3BucketName.description: Bucket name only, for example company-docs. Not a URL, s3:// path, or folder.

S3AccessKey.description: Access key ID. Leave both keys empty for a public bucket.

BaseUrl.description: Base URL for accessing stored objects.

DashboardUrl.description: Browser URL for the storage service dashboard.

SearchRequest.description: Verbex or RecallDB search request payload. Verbex index search supports opt-in enriched result fields.

Query.description: Search query text. Use * to browse Verbex index records.

MaxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

UseAndLogic.description: When true, all Verbex query terms must match.

IncludeMatchedTerms.description: Verbex index search only. Include MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeTermDetails.description: Verbex index search only. Include per-term score/frequency details and MatchedTerms on each result.

IncludeDocumentTermStats.description: Verbex index search only. Include whole-document UniqueTermCount and TotalTermOccurrences.

SearchResponse.description: Verbex or RecallDB search response payload.

Details.description: Safe detail payload for UI display.

SlackVerificationRequest.description: Draft Slack settings used for connectivity verification.

TelemetrySettings.description: OpenTelemetry / observability settings. These describe where metrics and traces are exported; the emit surface itself ( AssistantHubTelemetry ) has no dependency on any exporter. A telemetry host in the server/MCP executable reads these values (with environment variables overriding, see below) and wires the OTLP pipeline. Environment overrides: ASSISTANTHUB_TELEMETRY_ENABLED (true/false) overrides Enable , and ASSISTANTHUB_OTLP_ENDPOINT overrides OtlpEndpoint .

Enable.description: Whether telemetry export is enabled. Default false; the docker observability stack sets the ASSISTANTHUB_TELEMETRY_ENABLED environment variable to true.

ServiceName.description: The logical service name stamped as the service.name resource attribute. Null uses the host default (assistanthub-server or assistanthub-mcp).

OtlpEndpoint.description: The OTLP collector endpoint. Default http://localhost:4317 (gRPC). In docker this is set via the ASSISTANTHUB_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable to the collector service.

OtlpProtocol.description: The OTLP wire protocol: Grpc (port 4317) or HttpProtobuf (port 4318). Default Grpc.

SamplingRatio.description: Head-based trace sampling ratio in the range 0.0 to 1.0. Default 1.0 (sample everything).

EnableRuntimeMetrics.description: Whether to include .NET runtime instrumentation (GC, heap, threads). Default true.

ExportIntervalMs.description: Metric export interval in milliseconds for the periodic OTLP reader. Default 15000.

Terms.description: Distinct terms extracted from the content.

DashboardUrl.description: Browser URL for the Verbex dashboard.

DefaultIndexId.description: Default index identifier used for document ingestion.

EnableIngestion.description: Enable document text ingestion into Verbex.

RequireIngestion.description: Fail document ingestion when Verbex indexing fails.

MaxContentCharacters.description: Maximum normalized content characters sent to Verbex for one record. Zero means unlimited.

MaxConcurrentIndexingRequests.description: Maximum concurrent document indexing requests sent to Verbex by this process.

IndexingRetryCount.description: Number of retries for transient Verbex indexing failures.

IndexingRetryDelayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds before retrying a transient Verbex indexing failure.

EnableLemmatizer.description: Enable lemmatization on Verbex indexes that AssistantHub creates, so inflected forms ("running", "ran") match their base form. Applies to new indexes only; Verbex fixes the option when the index is created.

EnableStopWordRemover.description: Enable stop-word removal on Verbex indexes that AssistantHub creates. Applies to new indexes only.

MinTokenLength.description: Minimum token length indexed by Verbex indexes that AssistantHub creates (0 disables the limit). Applies to new indexes only.

MaxTokenLength.description: Maximum token length indexed by Verbex indexes that AssistantHub creates (0 disables the limit). Applies to new indexes only.

FollowRedirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects, one hop at a time, up to MaxRedirects. A redirect loop ends the chain and the page is skipped; when false, redirecting pages are skipped.

MaxRedirects.description: Most redirects followed for one page (1 to 50). A longer chain is skipped.

CredentialOrigins.description: Additional origins (absolute http or https URLs, for example https://docs.example.com) that receive the crawl's credentials. By default credentials go only to the start URL's origin.

DocumentSupersedesRequest.description: Request to set the documents a document supersedes.

SupersedesDocumentIds.description: Identifiers of the documents this document replaces. An empty list clears the links.

IngestionExtractionConfig.description: Extraction and intake settings for an ingestion rule: options passed to DocumentAtom when a document is extracted, and how duplicate uploads are handled.

OcrEmbeddedImages.description: Run OCR on images embedded in PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and RTF documents. Null uses DocumentAtom's default (on).

CsvHasHeaderRow.description: Treat the first row of a CSV or TSV file as its header row. Null uses DocumentAtom's default (true).

CsvRowsPerAtom.description: Number of CSV or TSV rows per extracted table (0 or null keeps the whole file as one table).

ExcelHeaderRowScoreThreshold.description: Score a spreadsheet row must reach to be detected as a header row. Null uses DocumentAtom's default (3).

DuplicatePolicy.description: What to do when an upload's content exactly matches a document already in the rule's collection: "Allow" (ingest it), "Warn" (ingest it and record the match) or "Reject" (refuse the upload with 409).

NearDuplicateThreshold.description: Similarity (0 to 1) at which another document in the collection is recorded as a near-duplicate after ingestion, using the new document's first chunk. 0 disables the check. Default 0.85.

RerankerTestRequest.description: Request to score passages with a reranker.

Scores.description: One score per document, in request order (0 to 1 for cross-encoders).
